text: Neither `delete-api-workspace-projects-id` nor `post-api-workspace-projects` says how the route answers when the workspace the process serves lost its stored registry entry after the start (another process of this machine detached it). Registration already refused it (a plain error, 500); removal answered 200 with a stale list and could purge the slot. Assumed: both refuse it the same way, before anything is written, retired or purged, as 409 with the `{ error: { code, message } }` envelope and code WORKSPACE_NOT_REGISTERED (the code the CLI already uses for a workspace this machine has not registered).
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-0603 — a workspace whose stored entry is gone: POST and DELETE /api/workspace/projects answer 409 WORKSPACE_NOT_REGISTERED, nothing written.
